name: FLAN-T5-DeepMind-LinAlg-1D-benchmark
description: A benchmark of linear-algebra (1D) problems designed to evaluate FLAN-T5 and similar models on basic vector and 1D-array operations, reasoning about linear algebra procedures, and numeric output generation. Tasks typically require following algorithmic steps and producing precise numeric or structured outputs. The suite stresses symbolic/numeric reasoning rather than natural-language understanding.
reputation: A focused evaluation set used by researchers benchmarking instruction-tuned models on math/linear-algebra capabilities; limited but growing usage.
